title: Engineering Manager Thailand
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

Â 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology â setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality â when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Facilities Planner

In this role, youâll closely impact the mission byâ¯maintaining infrastructure in government space, such as power, heating, and cooling, closely involved in those aspects such as a government power outage. With mentoring, exposure to challenging projects, and opportunities to learn new tools and skills, we focus on growing as a team to make the best solutions for our customers.

Join us. The world canât wait.

  • 2+ years of experience with planning, coordinating, and managing Military Construction (MILCON) and Unspecified Minor Construction (UMC) and understanding their processes through the Project Objective Memorandum (POM)
  • 2+ years of experience demonstrating and communicating with installations for planning concepts, principles, techniques, and practices of MILCON and UMC efforts

  • Experience working independently without specific guidelines to identify facility requirements and interpret, adapt, and apply policies, guides, procedures, regulations, and precedents to new or unique situations

  • Secret clearance

title: Technician
description:
Technician

The Security Centre Limited is seeking a technically capable and customer-focused Technician to join our Systems Department. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance, servicing, and troubleshooting of electronic security systems, including intruder alarms, card access systems, CCTV, and commercial fire systems.

The Technician will make a significant contribution to the success of the Systems Department by delivering high-quality technical work, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring projects and service requirements are completed safely, efficiently, and to the satisfaction of our clients.


Location: Cayman Islands

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Reports to: Systems Department Management


About the Role

This is a hands-on technical role supporting the delivery of electronic security projects and ongoing maintenance services across residential and commercial environments.

The successful candidate will work across the full project lifecycle, from cable installation and device deployment through to control panel termination, system commissioning, troubleshooting, and client handover.


The role will also support related electrical, communications, audio-visual, security lighting, telephone, cabling, and home automation projects, while working closely with the Sales and Systems teams, manufacturers, customers, and other stakeholders.

A key part of the role is ensuring that all work is completed in accordance with company standards, client requirements, project specifications, contractual commitments, and applicable safety requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Installation & Commissioning


â¢ Install electronic security systems and associated equipment in residential and commercial environments.

â¢ Run and terminate cables in accordance with system and project requirements.

â¢ Execute control panel terminations and associated wiring.

â¢ Install security devices, sensors, readers, cameras, panels, and other system components.

â¢ Establish Central Station connections and complete system commissioning.

â¢ Test systems to ensure correct operation and compliance with project specifications.

â¢ Support client handovers and provide appropriate system guidance where required.


Service, Maintenance & Troubleshooting

â¢ Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance on security systems.

â¢ Diagnose and troubleshoot system faults and technical issues.

â¢ Carry out repairs and corrective works as required.

â¢ Maintain accurate records of service activities, faults, repairs, and system performance.

â¢ Respond professionally and efficiently to client service requirements.

â¢ Ensure systems remain operational, reliable, and fit for purpose.


Electronic Security Projects

â¢ Assist the Sales and Systems teams with the design, sourcing, ordering, installation, and commissioning of electronic security projects.

â¢ Support both reactive and proactive security projects.

â¢ Assist with project planning, equipment requirements, installation activities, and commissioning.

â¢ Work to agreed labour, equipment, and project timelines.

â¢ Contribute to the successful completion and delivery of projects to customer expectations.

â¢ Identify opportunities for system improvements and additional client requirements.


Related Technical Services

â¢ Perform electrical and civil works associated with security installations.

â¢ Support projects involving security lighting, telephones, audio-visual systems, home automation, and structured cabling.

â¢ Assist with the integration of security systems and related technologies where required.

â¢ Apply sound technical judgement when working with existing infrastructure and client premises.

Customer & Supplier Relationships

â¢ Develop and maintain strong working relationships with product and equipment manufacturers.

â¢ Build positive and professional relationships with commercial and residential customers.

â¢ Communicate clearly with clients regarding technical requirements, project progress, service issues, and completion.

â¢ Represent The Security Centre Limited professionally at all times.

â¢ Maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction and service quality.


Administration, Compliance & Safety

â¢ Complete administrative tasks, service documentation, project records, and reports requested by the Head of Department.

â¢ Comply with all rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of The Security Centre Limited.

â¢ Comply with applicable requirements and rules established by clients while working on their premises.

â¢ Follow all company health and safety requirements and maintain safe working practices.

â¢ Complete required safety training and ensure all work is carried out in accordance with established procedures.

â¢ Support compliance with the policies and procedures outlined in the Employee Handbook.

â¢ Perform other duties as assigned by the Management Team from time to time.


What We're Looking For

Essential experience includes:


â¢ Experience in electronic security systems, electrical work, telecommunications, structured cabling, or a related technical field.

â¢ Strong practical skills in cable installation, termination, and equipment installation.

â¢ Ability to read and understand technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and system specifications.

â¢ Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

â¢ Ability to work safely with electrical and electronic equipment.

â¢ Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

â¢ Good communication and customer service skills.

â¢ Ability to work independently and as part of a technical team.

â¢ Ability to manage multiple assignments and work within established project timelines.

â¢ Valid driver's licence and ability to travel to client sites as required.


Experience with intruder alarms, access control, CCTV, commercial fire systems, Central Station connections, security lighting, home automation, audio-visual systems, or structured cabling would be a strong advantage.


The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

â¢ Technically capable, practical, and hands-on

â¢ Customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service

â¢ Strong at troubleshooting and finding practical solutions

â¢ Detail-oriented and committed to quality workmanship

â¢ Reliable, organised, and accountable

â¢ Comfortable working on construction sites, commercial premises, and residential properties

â¢ Able to work effectively under project and service deadlines

â¢ Professional and confident when dealing with customers, suppliers, and colleagues

â¢ Committed to following safety, company, and client procedures

â¢ Willing to continuously develop their technical knowledge and skills


This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded individual to develop their career within one of the Cayman Islands' leading security companies while working with a broad range of electronic security technologies and projects.

description:
General Manager - Suriname

We are a global leader in the Transportation and Logistics industry, aiming to strengthen our presence in the Caribbean Islands. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced General Manager to lead our operations in Suriname. The Branch Manager will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of our business operations, driving strategic initiatives, and ensuring the achievement of company goals. title: Engineer Estimator
description:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a leading provider of premium glass products, dedicated to transforming spaces with elegance and sophistication. With a commitment to craftsmanship and innovation, we specialize in designing and manufacturing high-quality glass solutions for residential and commercial projects.

Founded in 2017 in New York, the company has expanded its presence with offices in Los Angeles, Florida, and Texas. As a nationwide company, we serve clients across America, offering our signature glass products and services to diverse markets.

Following consistent annual growth of 70-80% and with even more ambitious plans ahead, we are expanding our recruitment team and looking for a Cost Engineer-Estimator to help drive our continued success.

Employment Type:

  • Full-time, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM, New York time
  • Remote work.

Responsibilities:

  • Review architectural drawings and submitted quotes to determine suitable installation options for our systems, including glass, aluminum, and steel partitions
  • Perform precise take-offs for all door and partition openings based on architectural and shop drawings
  • Read and interpret door schedules and hardware sets to ensure accurate product selection and full compatibility
  • Communicate effectively with the sales team to clarify project scope, technical requirements, and deadlines
  • Request necessary documentation, including compliance and regulatory certifications, as needed
  • Prepare detailed quotes that clearly define included materials, scope of work, exclusions, and any relevant assumptions or conditions
  • Identify and correct technical errors made by sales managers and propose appropriate alternatives or solutions

Requirements

  • Technical degree in Mechanical or Civil/Structural Engineering
  • Strong spatial thinking and technical problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience with quantity take-offs from construction and mechanical drawings
  • Confident in reading and interpreting:
  • Civil and mechanical drawings Hardware sets and layouts
  • Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Basic formulas
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently
  • Comfortable working with scaled PDFs (e.g., in Adobe Acrobat)
  • Languages: Russian (fluent), English (Upper-intermediate B2)
  • Available to work full-time aligned with EST timezone (8:30AM-5:00PM)

Benefits

  • Clear opportunities for career development and salary increase
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Work with a diverse and talented group of professionals
  • Supportive and innovative work environment
  • Paid days off and Sick leave

Please note: this is a fully remote, full-time position with a schedule from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM (New York time).

The candidate should have strong written and verbal English communication skills (B2 level or higher) and a technical degree or proven experience as a Engineer / Estimator.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. title: Valet Driver
description:
WE TAKE YOU ABOVE BEYOND

Take your passion to the next level and work alongside other masters of their craft to build a fulfilling and rewarding career at Marina Bay Sands.

Summary Of Job Responsibilities

As a Valet driver, you will be responsible for handling all arrivals, and departing vehicles at the Hotel Valet, Casino Valet, Carpark Valet, MICE, and Hall Parking. Additionally, you are required to perform static duties at the curb to direct traffic, assist in opening vehicle doors and not limited to assist on luggage for arrival at the Hotel driveway. You are expected to deliver the required service standard based on Forbes service standards consistently.

You must perform and support the Valet operations, and under the supervision of Valet Captains, and Managers to ensure that all the tasks are being completed on time and based on the standards set by the department. You should also work in close collaboration with other Valet drivers, traffic marshals and the bellman who are on duty at the driveway to ensure seamless arrival and departure for all guests.

Job Responsibilities

  • Handle valet vehicles within the property of Marina Bay Sands in line with the departmental standards
  • Operate the Valet Management System according to departmental guidelines.
  • Assist in managing the traffic around the property of Marina Bay Sands as well as ensuring and maintaining safety of guests and vehicles.
  • Provide level of service and experience according to the departmental audit standards and work as a team to achieve the departmental KPIs.
  • Direct incoming vehicles to the designated lanes and into specific areas of self-park whenever required.
  • Restrict incoming vehicles and manage taxi queue when required to ease congestion within the property.
  • Manage Hall Parking in the event of self-park overflow.
  • Provide information on valet and self-park related as well as all other guestsâ queries.
  • Understand and execute departmental game plans.
  • Maintain operational equipment in working order and ensure supplies are sufficient to perform duties.
  • Monitor and report any anomalies to Valet Captains for immediate action.
  • Learn and support the team with any other operational and/or departmental duties when required.
  • Assist with any other assignments tasked by Valet Captains

Job Requirements

Education & Certification

  • No formal education required

Experience

  • Possess a valid Singapore Class 3 Driving License with a minimum of 2 years driving experience.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is an advantage.

Other Prerequisites

  • Good interpersonal and English communication skills, proactive and positive attitude
  • Able to work within a culturally diverse team.
  • Able to deploy in environment as required to perform job responsibility
  • Able to perform manual handling duties, including lifting and moving guests' luggage.
  • Able to perform shift duties including night shift, and work on weekends and Public Holidays
  • Able to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working outdoors and standing for extended periods as required by operational needs
  • Able to safely operate vehicles and identify traffic signs, signals, and parking indicators required for the role.
  • Possess basic knowledge of Singapore attractions and places of interest.

Marina Bay Sands is committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, providing equal opportunities as we grow our talent base to match our growth ambitions in Singapore. Our employees are committed to adhere to and abide by all rules, regulations, policies and procedures, including the rules of conduct and business ethics of the Company.

title: Professorship (W2) in Data Science and Digital Systems (100%) (m/f/d)
description:
Characteristics

  • Fixed-term employment contract (initially for two years)
  • Full-time
  • Hannover, Munich, Leipzig, Remote
  • Published on 30.07.2026
  • Application deadline: 31.12.2026
  • Earliest start date: 01.08.2027

About us

velpTEC is an education institute focused on innovative technologies, combining experience from business, future studies, and new educational approaches. Through our educational offerings, we support people in strengthening their skills for the future in a practice-oriented way, helping them actively shape their own paths in life – and from 2027 onward, also in higher education.
VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) is a private university of applied sciences currently undergoing the process of state recognition through the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture. Our degree programs are launching in the fields of digital technologies, engineering, and innovation-driven management – with a clear commitment to continuously expanding our portfolio and responding to new developments. We understand teaching as a space for shaping solutions for tomorrow. Our approach is project-based, competency-oriented, and closely interlinked with practice. We are looking for individuals who are eager to break new ground in higher education and want to actively help shape our innovative learning environment. We are filling a W2-Professorship in Data Science and Digital Systems (100%).


Your responsibilities

  • Program development: Contributing to the development of the Master's program in Technology Business Management, and assisting in recruiting students
  • Masterclasses and expert seminars: Conducting live sessions on big data, business intelligence, cloud infrastructures, and data-driven technologies in English
  • Student supervision and examination formats: Providing academic guidance, mentoring, and support for project and research work; designing and evaluating portfolio assessments, exams, and master's theses
  • Applied research: Conducting practice-oriented research and transfer projects in the areas of data science, data infrastructures, and digital transformation – in cooperation with industry and research institutions
  • Funding and cooperation: Initiating research collaborations and acquiring third-party funding to strengthen applied research at our university
  • Publications and presentations: Publishing research findings in academic journals and at relevant conferences, as well as representing the university at specialist presentations and industry events
  • Transfer: Willingness to participate in research-related product developments, founding/start-up ventures, and patent applications
  • University development: Contributing to the university's academic self-governance, helping to further develop the range of study programs, and participating in international collaboration


Recruitment and qualification requirements

The recruitment requirements for professors are governed by § 25 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act (NHG):

  • A completed university degree
  • Pedagogical-didactic aptitude confirmed through practical experience
  • Special aptitude for in-depth independent scholarly work, generally evidenced by an above-average doctorate in the fields of Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Data Science, or related fields
  • Special achievements in the application or development of scientific findings and methods over at least five years of professional practice, of which at least three years must have been carried out outside the higher education sector – preferably in data analytics, digital systems, or data-driven business processes


In addition, we assume

  • The ability and willingness to conduct teaching, research, and transfer activities in English.
  • Willingness to develop and further build higher education teaching competencies – particularly in (generative) AI-supported teaching.


In addition, we value

  • Innovative spirit in teaching: Motivation to develop and apply new didactic formats in data science and digital systems education
  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in AI, blockchain, robotics, and management
  • Practice and transfer orientation: Proven experience in industry or research projects related to implementing data science solutions or digital infrastructures in real-world contexts
  • International perspective: Experience in international contexts or motivation to integrate global developments in data and system sciences into teaching and research
  • Commitment to institutional development: Willingness to actively shape the foundation and growth of a new university
  • Research profile: A visible research focus in big data analytics, cloud systems, AI-based data analysis, or digital infrastructures
  • Knowledge and technology transfer: Understanding research as a bridge between science, industry, and society


What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.
  • A professorship with a clear focus on teaching, quality assurance, and applied research.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration with colleagues in robotics, blockchain, additive manufacturing, and innovation management.
  • Modern digital infrastructure and an innovative environment without outdated structures.
  • Collaboration with the Center for Higher Education Teaching (Kompetenzzentrum Lehre) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg on the development of higher education teaching competencies.
  • Fully remote in Germany or hybrid work from one of our offices in Hanover, Munich, or Leipzig
  • Flexible working hours coordinated within your team (no weekend work) – doctor's appointments, childcare, and other important commitments are easy to accommodate
  • 15% employer contribution to your company pension plan
  • 3 paid Educational Days per year for professional development + 1 additional day of annual leave for volunteer work
  • Access to 13,000+ fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass
  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation


Application documents and further information

  • Please submit your application, together with the required documents, in English via our online portal. You can access the online portal through the "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" button. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by post or email.
  • The following application documents are expected; mandatory documents are marked with *: 
    • *Cover letter
    • *CV (including an overview of previous employment since your first university degree, providing information on subject-related and application-oriented professional experience relevant to the advertised professorship; supporting documents such as employment references are welcome)
    • *Final certificate from the last general education school attended
    • *Certificates and/or diplomas for academic degrees (e.g., diploma, bachelor's, master's, doctorate)
    • *List of teaching activities
    • *Evidence of pedagogical-didactic aptitude (e.g., certificates for higher education teaching training, evaluation results of courses taught, teaching-related awards or scholarships)
    • *List of research activities
    • *List of publications and, where applicable, presentations
    • If applicable, list of third-party funding acquisitions
    • If applicable, list of international experience and cooperations
  • Application documents must be submitted as scans. Please use the upload fields provided in the online portal. For your cover letter, use the "Anschreiben" upload; for your CV, use the "Lebenslauf" upload; and for your employment references, use the "Arbeitszeugnis" upload. For all other documents, please use the "Andere" upload.
  • The recognition of foreign educational qualifications requires proof of equivalence. Initial points of contact can be found via the portal www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de or https://zab.kmk.org/de/zeugnisbewertung.
  • Equal opportunity and diversity are actively promoted and practiced at VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung). This position is explicitly open to people of all genders (m/f/d). Applications from female scientists are expressly welcomed.
  • Application costs will not be reimbursed. 
In the further course of the appointment procedure, candidates may be asked, upon request, to give a teaching session, outline a research project, and complete at least one interview. By submitting your application documents, you consent to them being forwarded to the Appointment Committee. Within the appointment procedure, certain persons/committee members have the right to inspect the documents. These include members of the Presidential Board, the Senate, the University Council, and the Appointment Committee, as well as the sponsoring institution (velpTEC GmbH). Furthermore, the Officer for Equality and Diversity, where applicable the Officer for (Severe) Disability, and the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture have the right to inspect the application documents. Application documents submitted to VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) are handled in accordance with data protection requirements and are used and stored exclusively for the purposes of the appointment procedure. They will not be passed on to third parties. Upon conclusion of the appointment procedure, the application documents will be destroyed in compliance with the relevant data protection requirements. title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Support Group

As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. 

During the years we've invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it's the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations' quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.

About the Support Analytics Team

Our Support Analytics team's main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 

You'll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

Our humble expectations

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in a data science or analytics position
  • Experience building forecasting models and time series analysis (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)
  • Experience in Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis
  • Deep knowledge of statistical packages in Python or R
  • Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets
  • Ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders Good to have:
  • Experience using ML for forecasting
  • Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform
  • Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
  • You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in Berlin. 💙 
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via  

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: OEM Applications Engineer - EMEA
description:
Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Evident employs around 4,500 people at a total of 57 locations worldwide. Evident Europe, headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, employs approximately 770 people in 16 countries. The product portfolio includes a wide range of microscope systems used in clinical diagnostics, medical and basic research, as well as in various industrial areas.

At Evident, we deliver optical technology that pushes the limits of scientific discovery. Through advanced microscopy solutions, we help researchers and innovators illuminate the unseen.

Tasks

We’re looking for an OEM Applications Engineer, who plays a critical role in securing long-term design wins by engaging with OEM customers early in the development of next-generation instruments. This role combines deep technical expertise in optical systems with a strong consultative approach to influence system architecture decisions and position optical solutions as enabling technologies within customer platforms.

Working closely with OEM Sales, Product Management, and R&D, the Applications Engineer acts as a trusted technical advisor to customer engineering teams, helping define system requirements, evaluate optical architectures, and optimize instrument performance.

The role focuses on early design-cycle engagement, platform influence, and long-term OEM partnerships, ensuring that optical solutions become an integral part of customer instruments across life science and industrial markets.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Early Design-Cycle Engagement

• Engage with customer R&D teams during concept and architecture phases of instrument development.
• Influence optical system design to ensure optimal integration of optical solutions.
• Identify opportunities where optical performance can enable new instrument capabilities.

Design-Win Development

• Support OEM sales teams in securing strategic design wins within key accounts.
• Develop technical solution strategies tailored to customer system architectures.
• Provide technical leadership during design reviews and feasibility discussions.

System Architecture Consulting

• Work with customer engineering teams to define optimal optical configurations, including objectives, illumination systems, and imaging pathways.
• Evaluate trade-offs in optical performance, system cost, manufacturability, and integration complexity.
• Support prototype development and system validation.

Strategic Customer Partnerships

• Build trusted relationships with customer R&D leaders and system architects.
• Act as a long-term technical partner throughout the lifecycle of customer platforms.
• Provide insights into emerging technology trends and application needs.

Market & Technology Intelligence

• Capture insights on emerging applications, instrument architectures, and technology requirements.
• Provide structured feedback to Product Management and R&D to influence future product development.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Collaborate with global applications engineering, product management, and R&D teams to develop integrated solutions.
• Support the creation of reference architectures and application frameworks for OEM customers.
• Collaborate and consult with commercial team on account strategy planning and design win positioning.

Requirements

Education:

Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Optical Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Biomedical Engineering, Imaging Science, or related discipline.

Experience:

• 5 - 10 years experience in optical systems, microscopy, or scientific instrumentation.
• Experience working with OEM customers in instrument development environments.
• Demonstrated ability to support design-in or system architecture discussions with engineering teams.

Skills:

• Strong understanding of optical system design and performance, microscopy and imaging techniques, illumination and detection systems, and system-level performance optimization.
• Experience with optical design software (e.g., Zemax) is beneficial.

Other Considerations (travel/hours availability, etc.):

30–50% travel within EMEA to support customer design activities and strategic technical engagements.

Preferred locations include major European photonics and instrumentation hubs, such as:

• Germany (Munich, Jena, Oberkochen)
• Netherlands (Eindhoven)
• UK (Cambridge, Oxford)
• Switzerland
• France (Paris / Grenoble)

The role can be home-based with travel.

Core Evident Behaviors

• Think Big- Sets ambitious goals, thinks beyond the immediate and works outside of own area for insight and inspiration to excel
• Own the outcome- takes a high degree of personal accountability, ownerships and embraces a customer-centric approach to prioritization, planning and work
• Test. Decide. Go-Open minded, willing to try new things, balances risk with agility in a culture of learning and rapid growth, moves at pace to get the right things done
• Kaizen Everywhere, Everyday - Solicits feedback to enhance effectiveness, continually identifies and drives improvement and new ways of working, operating and thinking

  • Flexible working hours, incl. mobile work
  • 30 days of holiday time each year
  • 13 salaries a year
  • Regular training courses
  • Extensive company pension scheme
  • Payments towards an employee savings plan
  • Preventive healthcare
  • Joint company events and activities
  • Interesting, diversified field of activity in an international working environment

Evident Europe GmbH is an equal opportunities employer and we look forward to receiving your application.

title: Working Student – Robot Pilot / Data Collection (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Working Student – Robot Pilot / Data Collection (m/f/d), you are the hands-on operational backbone of our physical AI data pipeline. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it. You will directly operate state-of-the-art robotic systems to collect high-quality training data, playing a foundational role in how our robots learn new tasks through imitation and perception.

Your Responsibilities

  • Operate industrial robotics equipment using VR-based teleoperation systems and alternative control interfaces on-site.

  • Demonstrate complex manipulation tasks to generate clean, high-precision datasets for AI and imitation learning models.

  • Record and track repeated training episodes systematically, adhering strictly to experimental procedures and guidelines.

  • Review collected data episodes to perform immediate quality assurance and flag obvious operational or recording errors.

  • Document technical bugs, edge cases, and system anomalies clearly to support hardware and software engineering teams.

  • Provide continuous user feedback to improve the design, ergonomics, and usability of our robot control interfaces.

  • Ensure safe, careful, and responsible handling of advanced robotic systems and experimental hardware at all times.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Currently enrolled in or completed vocational training/a degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience with technical devices, gaming, VR headsets, remote-control systems, or activities requiring strong hand-eye coordination.

  • High concentration, patience, and attention to detail during repetitive, quality-critical tasks.

  • Culture-aligned mindset: Strong ownership mindset, high reliability, punctuality, and a pragmatic working style.

  • Very good English skills (German is a plus).

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

title: Staff ML Research Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world's smartphones, connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem.

Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Scalable Discovery & Engagement

The Data Science Research team builds foundational ML representations and advanced AI capabilities that enhance both Playtime and adjoe Ads. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI and deep learning approaches—specifically generative approaches —to deliver critical systems such as high-dimensional user embeddings, general content understanding and sequential recommendation. These frameworks scale adjoe's products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users.

The team operates at the intersection of bleeding-edge R&D and high-scale production engineering, acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser and primary consulting layer for complex ML bottlenecks. The stack is optimized for deep learning and heavy data throughput: PyTorch and [Ray/Hugging Face] for training and fine-tuning foundation models, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure for heavy workloads. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain high-throughput, realtime production environments.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • PhD or equivalent research depth, with a track record of technical mentorship. PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics. Publications in SIGIR, KDD, NeurIPS, or ICLR, and 5+ years building large-scale recommender systems in AdTech, e-commerce, or social. You've owned architectural bets and had accountability for outcomes.

  • You set the research direction. You identify the highest-leverage problems at the intersection of generative AI and recommendation, define the multi-quarter research agenda, and align engineering and product leadership. That means owning how Generative Retrieval, Deep Ranking, and Re-ranking evolve across a stack built on 770 million users' behavioral data.

  • Deep expertise in PyTorch and large-scale model optimization. Hands-on with high-concurrency optimization, quantization, and distillation — getting large generative models to run under extreme production constraints, not just in research environments.

  • You are the company's deepest resource on generative recommendation. You translate SOTA research into systems adjoe can ship, review architectural decisions across teams, and raise the ML quality bar company-wide. When there's a hard bottleneck, you're the first call.

  • You grow the teams around you. You mentor senior and mid-level scientists, lead architectural debates, and drive long-horizon investments without needing a roadmap handed to you.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Werde Teil unseres Tax-Teams – bei den Beratern der Weltmarktführer.

cbs Corporate Business Solutions GmbH ist eine führende Unternehmensberatung mit Fokus auf SAP und Prozessoptimierung. Seit über 30 Jahren begleiten wir Weltmarktführer bei der digitalen Transformation und gestalten nachhaltige Lösungen für globale Geschäftsprozesse.

Internationale Steuern, Pillar Two, Digitalisierung; in dieser neu geschaffenen Schlüsselrolle im Headquarter der cbs Gruppe gestalten Sie die steuerliche Ausrichtung auf Konzernebene gemeinsam mit dem Head of Tax aktiv mit und übernehmen Verantwortung für alle internationalen und nationalen Steuerfragestellungen der cbs Gruppe.

Was Dich erwartet

Tax-Expert:

  • Bearbeitung und Koordination vielfältiger steuerlicher Fragestellungen im internationalen Kontext (z. B. Ertragsteuern, Quellensteuern, Betriebsstätten)

  • Strategische Steuerung und konzernweite Implementierung der globalen Mindestbesteuerung (OECD Pillar Two) einschließlich Aufbau entsprechender Prozesse, Datenstrukturen und Reporting-Anforderungen

  • Zentrale Ansprechperson für lokale Steuerberater sowie Schnittstelle zu internen Bereichen wie Accounting, Controlling, Legal und IT

  • Mitarbeit und perspektivisch Übernahme von Verantwortung in funktionsübergreifenden Projekten mit steuerlichem Bezug

Tax-Compliance:

  • Koordination der Steuererklärungen und sonstigen Compliance-Tätigkeiten der in- und ausländischen Tochtergesellschaften der cbs Gruppe  in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit den externen Beratern der lokalen Einheiten

Tax-Kalkulationen:

  • Erstellung des Steuer-Forecasts sowie Koordination der Steuerberechnungen im Rahmen des Jahresabschlusses einschließlich Ermittlung latenter Steuern nach HGB auf Konzernebene.

Tax-Audits:

  • Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen und Koordination von steuerlichen Anfragen der Finanzbehörden


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Steuern/Steuerrecht oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Tax-Bereich eines international tätigen Unternehmens oder einer Beratungsgesellschaft

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im internationalen Steuerrecht, idealerweise bereits Kenntnisse zu OECD Pillar Two

  • Erfahrung mit Tax-Compliance-Prozessen

  • Ausgeprägtes Maß an Eigeninitiative sowie eine lösungsorientierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Hohe Motivation und Freude an der Gestaltung und dem Ausbau der Steuerfunktion

  • IT-Affinität zum Ausbau und zur Digitalisierung von Prozessen

  • Kommunikationsstärke und sicheres Auftreten im internationalen Umfeld; sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir dir bieten

  • Breites Aufgabenspektrum mit der Kombination aus operativer Steuerarbeit und strategischen Zukunftsthemen, insbesondere im Kontext internationaler Entwicklungen wie OECD Pillar Two

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Tax und direkte Einbindung in steuerliche Entscheidungsprozesse auf Konzernebene

  • Flache Hierarchien mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, kollegialer Unternehmenskultur und hoher Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit

  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum und individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer nachhaltig wachsenden, international ausgerichteten Unternehmensgruppe

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung mit der Möglichkeit zum hybriden Arbeiten

Unsere Benefits:

Aus- und Weiterbildung

SAP- und Salesforce-Zertifizierungen, Competence Center-Tage, Fachspezifische Schulungen

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Zusatzversicherungen, diverse Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, Yoga etc.

Events

Beratertage, Weihnachtsfeier, Sommerfest, Teamevents, Alumni-Treffen, Jubiläumsfeiern und -reisen

Prämien

Umsatzbeteiligungen, Prämienzahlungen für erfolgreich abgeschlossene Projekte, Attraktive Gehaltsmodelle, Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprämien

Arbeitszeiten

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, mobiles Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub, Workation

Ausstattung

Firmenhandy (iPhone), Notebook / Macbook, Mitarbeiter PC Programm, Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, Kostenlose Getränke, Gemeinschaftsräume mit Wohlfühlcharakter

Firmenwagen

Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte/ Mobilitätspauschale, Bahncard, Jobrad

Zuwendungen

Zuschüsse für Kindergarten/Kita und außerordentliche Zuwendungen je Lebenssituation und Betriebszugehörigkeit

title: Werkstudent*in Influencer Marketing DACH (m/w/d)
description:
Woran Du arbeitest

Was verbindet die DACH-Region mit KoRo? Die Liebe zu gutem Essen und bewusstem Genuss! Du brennst für Social-Media-Trends in der DACH-Region und unterstützt unser Team gerne dabei, aufstrebende Influencerinnen zu identifizieren. Als echtes Teammitglied hilfst du dabei, Beziehungen zu den richtigen Partnerinnen aufzubauen, um unsere Produkte noch bekannter zu machen. Mit deiner Begeisterung und deinem Organisationstalent spielst du eine wichtige Rolle beim Wachstum unserer Marke in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören dabei unter anderem:

  • Du wirkst aktiv am Ausbau unserer Markenpräsenz in der DACH-Region mit, indem du erfolgreiche Kooperationen mit relevanten Influencer*innen auf verschiedenen Plattformen aufbaust.

  • Du identifizierst, kontaktierst und verhandelst mit Influencer*innen und Agenturen, um beiderseitig vorteilhafte Partnerschaften aufzubauen, die mit unseren Unternehmenszielen im Einklang stehen.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen zur Steigerung der Markenbekanntheit und Interaktion im DACH-Markt.

  • Du verfolgst und analysierst den Erfolg von Influencer-Kooperationen anhand relevanter KPIs, um datenbasierte Entscheidungen zur Maximierung des ROI (Return on Investment) zu treffen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Teams zusammen, die auf den DACH-Markt ausgerichtet sind, um Influencer-Marketing sinnvoll in größere Kampagnen einzubetten und supportest das Team in administrativen Aufgaben & Projekten.

  • Du bleibst über aktuelle Branchentrends, Strategien von Wettbewerber*innen und neue Social-Media-Plattformen auf dem Laufenden, um unsere Marke im DACH-Raum weiter nach vorne zu bringen.


Was Du mitbringst

  • Du kannst uns idealerweise ab sofort unterstützen und 20 Stunden pro Woche mitarbeiten. Du kannst montags und donnerstags an Teammeetings teilnehmen.

  • Du bist derzeit an einer Universität eingeschrieben und studierst etwas im Bereich Wirtschaft, Kommunikation, Marketing oder ein vergleichbares Fach – als Werkstudentin musst du immatrikuliert sein!*

  • Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung und hast Lust, regelmäßig vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin-Schöneberg zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Herz schlägt für die DACH-Region – du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Influencer Marketing oder im Partnership Management sind von Vorteil.

  • Du bist kreativ, flexibel und gut organisiert. Und dank deines starken Zeitmanagements behältst du auch bei mehreren Projekten, Reizüberflutung oder fehlenden Vorgaben den Überblick und schaffst selbst Struktur. Mit deinen ausgeprägten Kommunikations- und Verhandlungskompetenzen baust und pflegst du Beziehungen, arbeitest gerne eigenständig und übernimmst Verantwortung.

  • Du kennst dich mit Social-Media-Plattformen aus – insbesondere im DACH-Raum – und hast Spaß daran, dich über aktuelle Trends im Influencer Marketing auf dem Laufenden zu halten.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Smart Working & Flexibility: Hybrides Arbeiten & flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich perfekt an deinen Vorlesungsplan oder deine Prüfungsphase anpassen lassen. Bei uns gibt es kein Kaffeekochen oder Kopieren – wir vertrauen auf deine Eigenverantwortung von Tag eins an.
  • Growth & Onboarding: Du bist vollwertiges Teammitglied! Mit deinen Ideen kannst du die Zukunft des Lebensmittelhandels in einem stark wachsenden Scale Up’s aktiv mitgestalten. Du erhältst ein strukturiertes Onboarding sowie dein eigenes MacBook für die Zeit bei uns.
  • KoRo Life & Extras: Finde den Weg (zurück) ins Gym dank unserer Fitness-Kooperationen wie Urban Sports Club oder FitX. Außerdem profitierst du von 20 % Discount in unserem KoRo-Online-Shop sowie exklusiven Vergünstigungen bei Partnerunternehmen. Im Office warten natürlich unsere Free Snacks und Barista-Kaffee auf dich!
  • Shared Moments: Regelmäßige Team-Events und Company Parties, um unsere Meilensteine und Erfolge gemeinsam zu feiern.
Deine Vergütung: Im Bachelor 15,00 € pro Stunde/ Im Master oder mit abgeschlossener Ausbildung 17,00€ pro Stunde


Wir suchen Menschen, die unser Mindset teilen

Bei uns geht es nicht nur um das Was, sondern vor allem um das Wie. Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn du folgendes Mindset mitbringst:

  • Du übernimmst Ownership. Du wartest nicht auf detaillierte Step-by-Step-Anweisungen. Wenn du Möglichkeiten siehst zu unterstützen, etwas zu verbessern oder zu lernen, bringst du dich aktiv ein und stellst Fragen. Du nimmst Feedback an und entwickelst dich weiter.
  • Du fühlst dich im Wandel zuhause. In einem schnellen Umfeld können sich Prioritäten schnell ändern – du siehst das als Teil des Learnings, nicht als Blocker. Du passt dich schnell an und bleibst flexibel.
  • Du baust auf, statt zu warten. Wenn etwas fehlt oder noch nicht rund ist, hilfst du dabei, eine pragmatische Lösung zu finden. Du entwickelst Ideen kontinuierlich weiter und setzt auf Learning by Doing statt auf Perfektion zu warten.
  • Du denkst in Impact. Du suchst das “Warum” hinter Aufgaben und Entscheidungen und bringst deine Perspektive ein.
  • Du bist ein echter Teamplayer. Du arbeitest gut im Team, kommunizierst offen und trägst zu einer positiven Teamdynamik bei. Du bist neugierig, respektvoll und offen für Feedback, lernst aktiv von anderen und bringst gleichzeitig deine eigenen Ideen ein.
Own it – Move fast – Build it – Create impact – Lift others


Sounds good?

Dann sende uns deine Bewerbung sowie alle relevanten Unterlagen (Lebenslauf und Motivationsschreiben) über unsere Website. Wir suchen Teammitglieder, keine reinen Arbeitskräfte! Wir sind gespannt, wer du bist und was dich bewegt – du kannst uns das gerne schon in ein paar einleitenden Sätzen in deiner Bewerbung verraten.

Your main goal is to drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by ensuring customers successfully adopt Ordio, renew their contracts, expand into additional locations, and use more of our products over time.

You will build strong customer relationships, identify growth opportunities early, and work closely with Sales, Product and Support to increase the long-term value of every account.

🤝 Close collaboration with Sales & Product: You ensure a smooth handover from Sales to Customer Success and work closely with Sales on account expansion opportunities. You also communicate customer feedback and feature requests to the Product team.

💡 Product Adoption: You proactively help customers get more value from Ordio by increasing adoption of relevant features, modules and workflows.

☎️ Professional Communication: You communicate confidently via email, telephone, chat and video, maintain clear follow-up routines and document customer activity and commercial opportunities accurately in the CRM.

Requirements

🇩🇪 German speaking (C1+)

💪 Previous experience in Customer Success within a SaaS or B2B software company.

📈 Experience managing and developing an existing customer portfolio, ideally with responsibility for metrics such as Net Revenue Retention, Gross Revenue Retention, renewals, churn or expansion revenue.

🚀 Proven experience identifying and closing upsell, cross-sell or account expansion opportunities.

🌍 Ideally, experience working with customers that operate across multiple locations, sites, regions or business units.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Your Impact

We have built a sales machine that works: ~90% of our AEs hit quota, our top performers achieve significantly more, we rarely lose head to head, and almost nobody who buys Tacto ever leaves. The bottleneck is no longer the market or the product, it is leadership capacity. We need managers who can turn good AEs into great ones at the speed we are hiring them.

As Sales Manager you own one customer segment and lead a team of ~5 Account Executives. You carry no personal quota. Your number is your team's number, and your job is the thing that produces it: the quality of your people, the rigor of your deal strategy, and the discipline of your pipeline. You will work directly with the founders and sales leadership on how we go to market in a segment where over 10,000 industrial companies in DACH still run procurement on Excel, and where we are the category of one.

Your Tasks

  • Own your segment's number through your team: You are measured on team attainment. You build the pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and win rates that make the number inevitable.

  • Team Development: Build and coach a high-performing sales team through structured training, hands-on deal support, and performance management. You'll model best practices while developing each team member's capabilities.

  • Deal Strategy & Execution: Actively join critical customer conversations, challenge assumptions, eliminate risks, and design winning game plans alongside your AEs. You'll roll up your sleeves to support negotiations and business case development.

  • Sales Excellence: Implement and coach on proven sales methodologies (MEDDIC) while creating a culture of continuous improvement through regular training in discovery, negotiation, and process management.

  • Performance Optimization: Drive team performance through structured metrics tracking, pipeline reviews, and action planning. You'll identify improvement opportunities and implement solutions that increase win rates and deal velocity.

  • Become AI Native: Proactively identify opportunities to leverage AI to accelerate the work of your team, experiment with new approaches, and share successful workflows – contributing to Tacto's culture of high-velocity execution and innovation.

Your Profile

  • 3+ years as an Account Executive in B2B SaaS with complex, non-transactional, multi-stakeholder sales

  • At least 1 year leading a sales team, ideally in a high-growth environment

  • A track record of consistently hitting or beating quota, as an individual and with a team

  • You coach from a real methodology, not from instinct, and you can teach it to someone who does not have it yet

  • You are strategic and tactical in the same week: you can design a segment plan on Monday and rescue a stalled deal on Thursday

  • You are direct. You give hard feedback early because you would rather have the uncomfortable conversation than watch someone miss

  • Resilient, high-agency, and drawn to a hard problem over an easy title

  • Fluent in German and English

Why this role is awesome

Product-market fit is not a hypothesis here. Customers stay, they grow, and our product team ships against a real vision, so every quarter your AEs walk into calls with something they could not say the quarter before. That means you will not spend your first year explaining why anyone should care. You will spend it coaching sellers who are ambitious, hungry to grow, and carry almost no ego about it, the kind who ask for feedback and then act on it. Whatever you have learned in your career lands on fertile soil here.

 

Why Tacto

  • A standout sales organization built for the long term

    • ~90% of AEs hit their quota, with top performers reaching up to 400%

    • Incentives that reward over-performance: 150% uncapped kicker

    • No compromises on the talent bar: a lean, high-density team of A-players who push each other, with zero elbow culture. We hire the best, incentivize them right, and promote from within.

  • Top-tier support so your team can focus on closing

    • CVMs recruited exclusively from top-tier consultancies (BCG, Inverto, AT Kearney, Oliver Wyman) own onboarding and tee up your upsells, a Proof of Value team builds your business case in 48 hours, plus dedicated Value Engineers, Solution Engineers, Sales Ops, and a BDR machine that delivers the majority of your qualified pipeline

  • A truly AI-native sales organization

    • Access to all the leading AI tools plus a stack of custom agents that handle the work that used to eat your week, from meeting prep and demo follow-ups to value cases, call coaching, and instant battlecards, so you spend your time selling, not preparing to sell

    • We invest to keep it that way: dedicated 'AI captains' across every team, with a group focused on Sales and Go-to-Market, building new tooling and running enablement so new knowledge spreads fast

  • Backed to win big

    • Sequoia- and Index-funded, with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda, from Sam Altman to Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem

    • Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events

    • e.g. Sales-focused Events with CRO of DeepL, CRO of Dash0 or ex Head of RevOps at Forto

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.
